text.en: When your opponent activates a monster effect, or their monster declares an attack: Add up to 2 Level 7 or higher DARK monsters with 2500 DEF from your Deck to your hand. If a face-up DARK monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; negate its effects. You can only use each effect of "Stairway to the Underworld" once per turn.
